entries.en: Is dat so? Worth it by how much?
People think Pacifica is de Third World – children playin' barefoot among ruin. But dey can't see de strength dat lies dormant here... Ha. One day, dey shall reckon with it.
entries.ro: Oamenii cred că Pacifica e Lumea a Treia – copii care se joacă desculți printre ruine. Dar nu văd puterea care zace aici, latentă... Ha. Într-o zi, or să afle pe pielea lor.
